t.zh: 观察一条由暗到亮的边界时，权重的方向会影响变化的符号。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>考察<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：追踪唯一亮点遇到的权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
t.en: When observing a dark-to-bright boundary, weight orientation affects the sign of the change. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to examine <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track the weight meeting the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的区别涉及权重的方向。对称权重可能掩盖方向差异，而不对称权重能帮助检查约定；数值相近的结果不一定表示使用了相同运算。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in weight orientation. Symmetric weights can hide that difference; asymmetric weights help check the convention. Similar-looking results do not necessarily imply the same operation.

brief.zh: 不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
brief.en: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

hint.zh: 亮点左边那一格，算加权和时亮点是它的哪个邻居？
hint.en: For the cell left of the bright one, which neighbour is the bright cell?

why.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
why.en: Expecting the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>, 0 outside.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> 不翻转；翻转之后，k1 落到哪一边？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> does not flip; flipped, which side does k1 land on?
